# mistershell_scheduled_task_config (Resource)

Binds configuration of an existing backend-owned object. Create captures originals and applies only configured fields; destroy restores those originals and never deletes the object. Removing a field restores and releases it. Import explicitly adopts current readable configuration. One binding per object/configuration surface. configuration fields: task_name, is_enabled, interval_minutes (>=1), timeout_seconds (60..86400), config (object or null), next_run (RFC3339 timestamp or null). next_run is a moving scheduler value; configuring it enforces that timestamp.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_scheduled_task_config" "cleanup" {
  task_type = "telemetry_data_cleanup"
}

resource "mistershell_scheduled_task_config" "cleanup" {
  id = data.mistershell_scheduled_task_config.cleanup.id
  configuration = {
    is_enabled       = true
    interval_minutes = 60
    timeout_seconds  = 300
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) configuration fields: task_name, is_enabled, interval_minutes (>=1), timeout_seconds (60..86400), config (object or null), next_run (RFC3339 timestamp or null). next_run is a moving scheduler value; configuring it enforces that timestamp.
- `id` (String) Existing object ID, stable catalog key, or local. This binding never creates the backend object.

### Read-Only

- `original_configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Original owned configuration retained in state for restoration. Do not edit; protect Terraform state.
